title: Explicit conditional bounds for $ζ(s)$ at the edge of the critical strip
summary: In this paper, we obtain explicit bounds for the real part of the logarithmic derivative of the Riemann zeta-function on the line $\re s=1$, assuming the Riemann hypothesis. The proof combines the Guinand--Weil explicit formula with extremal bandlimited majorants and minorants for the Poisson kernel. As an application, we revisit the classical estimates of Littlewood for the modulus of the Riemann zeta-function and of its reciprocal on the line $\re{s}=1$, and derive a slight refinement of the bounds of Lamzouri, Li, and Soundararajan.
